prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: sprite sheet for OpenVoiceOS setup wizard card illustrations
Primary request: One square 1536x1536 image containing FOUR completely separate stylized clay 3D concept vignettes in a mathematically perfect 2x2 grid, with no visible grid lines, borders, labels, or text.
Scene/backdrop: pure white (#ffffff) canvas throughout, pure white in every quadrant, soft small contact shadows only.
Subject: TOP LEFT quadrant: a friendly cobalt-blue voice-assistant pod with a small face/two eyes and a coral speech bubble, representing a ready-to-use assistant. TOP RIGHT quadrant: playful cyan and orange electronics building blocks with a tiny screwdriver, representing tinkering and building your own. BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: a tiny clean stylized white house with a blue roof and two small cyan voice pods, representing a home hub. BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: a simple blue celebration gift box with coral ribbon and a little confetti, representing a finished result.
Style/medium: conceptual illustrations, consistent isometric view, polished editorial 3D render with glossy ceramic plus soft matte plastic tactile materials. Charming, restrained, grown-up playful.
Composition/framing: four separate equal square 768x768 cells. Center each subject at its quadrant's center, respectively x25% y25%, x75% y25%, x25% y75%, and x75% y75%. Each vignette occupies only the middle 60 percent of its cell, leaving generous pure-white margins. Every object and shadow fully contained within its own quadrant; nothing overlaps or crosses between quadrants.
Lighting/mood: soft bright studio light, same light direction and perspective for all four.
Color palette: cobalt blue, bright cyan, coral, a little orange, pure white.
Constraints: no UI, no cards drawn behind the objects, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no borders, no watermark; not product photography.
